This writ petition coming on for Orders, this day the Court made the following:-
 ORDER Ms.Jayna Kothari, Adv., for Petitioner.

Learned counsel for Respondent Nos.1 and 2 has produced the statement of objections along with certain documents with photographs on the date of earlier survey and the inspection carried out by the Health Officer of the BBMP, on the complaint of non-maintenance of hygienic conditions in the central kitchen of the petitioner- company which runs a chain of restaurant in Bengaluru.

2. Learned counsel for respondent-BBMP informs the Court that the maximum penalty to be imposed for such alleged commission of offence committed by the petitioner Date of order :
9.11.2016 in WP.No.55536/2016 Billionsmiles Hospitality Pvt.Ltd. vs. The Commissioner, BBMP &
ors.

sentences.text: as per Schedule XI under Section 431 of the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act, 1976 is `500/- for each of such offence and therefore for the alleged offence the maximum penalty would be `1,000/-.
In view of the inspection carried out by the Health Inspector on 22.10.2016, learned counsel for respondent-BBMP, has submitted that the impugned order passed by the respondent-BBMP was justified.

3. However, Ms.Jayna Kothari, learned counsel for the petitioner-company, has submitted that the petitioner is a well known quick service restaurant chain in Bengaluru and it is maintaining proper hygienic conditions with all due care is maintained in and around the central kitchen of the petitioner-company and therefore the aforesaid report is not correct and no offence was committed by the petitioner-company.
4. The interim orders were passed by this Court on 27.10.2016 and 8.11.2016 permitting the petitioner to Date of order : 9.11.2016 in WP.No.55536/2016 Billionsmiles Hospitality Pvt.Ltd. vs.

sentences.text: In the meanwhile, the petitioner- company may be allowed to run its business in the aforesaid Central kitchen and no coercive process be taken against the petitioner-company without the leave of this Court.
However, the petitioner- company is also directed to maintain all hygiene and suitable cleanliness in and around the area where it is operating.

It is made clear to the petitioner-company that in case any violation is found on the hygienic conditions being maintained or food safety standards are not followed by it, not only the present writ petition will be dismissed with costs but the respondents- BBMP may be directed to initiate suitable action against the petitioner-company and its directions in this regard."
5.

In view of the aforesaid inspection carried by the respondents, the petitioner-company was asked as to Date of order : 9.11.2016 in WP.No.55536/2016 Billionsmiles Hospitality Pvt.Ltd. vs. The Commissioner, BBMP & ors. whether, without prejudice to its rights, the petitioner- company would be willing to deposit the said penalty amount of `1,000/- on the basis of the inspection carried out by the Health Officer of the BBMP.

entities.text: WP.No.55536/2016 Billionsmiles Hospitality Pvt.Ltd. vs. The Commissioner, BBMP & ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioner-company submitted that without prejudice to the right of the petitioner-company for challenging the said report and getting appropriate adjudication by the respondents, the petitioner-company would deposit the said amount of penalty of `1,000/.
6.

In view of the above, this Court is not inclined to proceed further with this case and the writ petition is disposed of with directions to the petitioner to deposit the said amount of `1,000/- before the Respondent No.2 and to make suitable representation raising its objections along with the relevant evidence before the concerned authority, which is expected to pass a speaking order within a period of four weeks from today.

The petitioner's authorizesd representative may appear before the Respondent No.2 in the first instance on 16th November, Date of order : 9.11.2016 in WP.No.55536/2016 Billionsmiles Hospitality Pvt.Ltd. vs. The Commissioner, BBMP & ors. 2016 and deposit the said amount of `1,000/-.
